TC-11/S12.title: Double tap on Generate, and leaving the chart while the note and timeline are still being written
TC-11/S12.detail: N3 re-check on 8b4be94a: FIXED (twice: runs 1 and 2). After Generate-and-leave the chart keeps a finished entry for the visit (not erased, no 'Encounter done'); after Regenerate-and-leave the entry is rewritten from the regenerated note (it names the 1 L / oral cefpodoxime facts only the second dictation had); the reopened chart shows the card; the other chart gained no note, course, encounter text or status. The course refresh now runs on the server after the note (convex/lib/noteFollowUps.ts), so leaving the page no longer matters. Seen in passing: the entry is filed under the server's UTC day next to the pre-round line still 'Encounter pending' (TC-11/S05, candidate rb2-C1). The double-tap half of the case was not re-run (it passed on 10-14). Case scope P1 (ours).
